opportunities.name: Hotel proposal email with currency conversion
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in {destination} for {check_in}–{check_out}, pick a hotel, convert its EUR price to {target_currency} on Xe, then email {recipient} a proposal asking for approval to book.
steps: On Booking.com, click the destination field, select all and type {destination}
Open the date picker, go to the right month with 'Next month' if needed, and click {check_in} and {check_out}
Click Search
Open the chosen hotel's page and note its name and total price in EUR
On Xe Currency Converter, set the amount to the EUR price, with EUR as the source currency
Set the target currency to {target_currency} (search the currency list and pick it), then click Convert and note the result
In mail, compose: To={recipient}, Subject='Hotel for {destination}, {check_in}-{check_out}'
Body: 'Hi {name}, proposed hotel: {hotel_name}, {price} EUR (about {converted} {target_currency}). OK to book?'
Send the email (in the recording it was discarded)

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20 2026; Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South 818 EUR -> 915.34 USD; maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1-4 2026; BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti 264 EUR -> 46,794 JPY; kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15 2027; Jan Luyken Amsterdam 577 EUR -> 487.44 GBP; aisha@example.com (a Zurich search started at t=792.4 was dropped before this one)

opportunities.name: City weather + strike news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up the 10-day forecast for {city} for {day}, search BBC for '{city} strike' and open the top article, then email {recipient} a heads-up with the forecast and the news headline.
steps: On the weather site, open location search, type {city} and pick the matching result
Open the '10 Day' forecast and note the high/low and conditions for {day}
On BBC, open search (menu or 'Search BBC'), type '{city} strike' and press Enter
Open the most relevant/top result and note the headline and date
In mail, compose: To={recipient}, Subject='Heads-up: {city} on {day}'
Body: 'Hi {name}, {city} on {day}: {high}°/{low}°, {conditions}. Latest news: {headline} ({date}).'
Send the email (in the recording it was discarded)

instances.values: Berlin, Saturday; 58°/44° Partly Cloudy; Students strike across Germany...; raj@example.com
Madrid, Monday; 64°/50° Partly Cloudy; Villa eye Endrick loan deal; sofia@example.com
London, Thursday; 70°/56° Cloudy; School support staff strike over pay; tom@example.com

opportunities.name: Visa requirement + public holiday travel note
opportunities.description: Look up the Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' page to find the rule for {destination_country}, check timeanddate.com holidays for that country in {month}, and save a summary note.
steps: On Wikipedia, search 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' and press Enter
Use Ctrl+F to find {destination_country} and note the visa requirement and allowed stay
On timeanddate.com, go to Holidays (dismiss the privacy dialog if it appears)
Search for or click {destination_country} (open the full holiday list if needed)
Note the holidays that fall in {month}
In Notes, create a new note: '{nationality_adj} traveler to {destination_country}: {visa_requirement}, allowed stay {stay}. Holidays in {month}: {holidays}' and press Enter

instances.values: Indian -> Japan; eVisa; December: no national holidays, Dec 31 bank holiday
Brazilian -> Canada; Visa required (eTA possible); November: Nov 11 Remembrance Day
Nigerian -> United Kingdom; Visa required; May: May 4 & May 25 bank holidays (interleaved with the Amsterdam hotel task)
